info.title: Slack Agent Gateway
info.description: Gateway service for multiple AI agents on Slack

post.description:
Handle Slack bot webhook requests.

This endpoint receives events from all configured Slack agent apps.
It verifies signatures, deduplicates events, and processes them.

Args:
    request: The incoming FastAPI request containing the Slack payload

Returns:
    JSONResponse with processing result

Get session info for Agent Service.

Requires X-API-Key header for authentication.

Args:
    request_body: Request containing session_id

Returns:
    SlackSessionInfoResponse with session details

Raises:
    HTTPException: If session not found

Add a new reply message to Slack.

Posts immediately to Slack as a new message in the thread.
Requires X-API-Key header for authentication.

Args:
    request_body: Request containing session_id and text

Returns:
    AddReplyResponse with success status and message_ts

Append text to the last reply (buffered).

Text is buffered and flushed to Slack at rate-limited intervals (~1.2s).
Requires X-API-Key header for authentication.

Args:
    request_body: Request containing session_id and text to append

Returns:
    AppendToReplyResponse with success status

Replace the content of the last reply.

Discards any pending buffer and replaces the message content.
Requires X-API-Key header for authentication.

Args:
    request_body: Request containing session_id and new text

Returns:
    UpdateReplyResponse with success status

Handle Slack interactivity payloads (button clicks, form submissions).

Slack sends these as application/x-www-form-urlencoded with a 'payload' field.
Signature is verified against all configured signing secrets.

Args:
    request: The incoming FastAPI request containing the Slack interaction payload

Returns:
    JSONResponse acknowledging the interaction

Handle Slack slash commands (e.g., /create-agent).

Slack sends commands as application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
Signature is verified using Bot Father's signing secret.

Args:
    request: The incoming FastAPI request containing the slash command payload

Returns:
    JSONResponse acknowledging the command (must respond within 3 seconds)

Request a feedback survey be posted to the Slack thread.

Requires X-API-Key header for authentication.

Args:
    request_body: Request containing session_id and optional prompt

Returns:
    RequestFeedbackResponse with success status and message_ts

Send a message to a Slack channel proactively.

Allows an agent to initiate a conversation by sending a message to any channel.
Does not require an existing session.
Requires X-API-Key header for authentication.

Args:
    request_body: Request containing agent_name, channel_id, text, and optional thread_ts

Returns:
    SendMessageResponse with success status and message_ts

Request creation of a new Slack bot for an agent.

Creates a pending bot creation request that must be approved via Slack.
Requires X-API-Key header for authentication.

Args:
    request_body: Request containing agent_name, slack_name, display_name, and requester info

Returns:
    BotCreationResponse with request_id and PENDING status

Raises:
    HTTPException: If agent already has a bot or a pending request exists

get.description:
Get the status of Slack bot setup for an agent.

Returns whether the agent has a live bot and any pending creation requests.
Requires X-API-Key header for authentication.

Args:
    agent_name: AHS agent name to check

Returns:
    BotStatusResponse with bot status and pending request info

Handle OAuth callback from Slack after app installation.

This endpoint is called by Slack when an admin completes the OAuth flow.
Slack redirects the admin's browser here with an authorization code.

No API key auth because this is a browser redirect from Slack.

Args:
    code: Authorization code from Slack (exchanged for bot token).
    state: State parameter (request_id) for CSRF protection.
    error: Error code if the user denied authorization.

Returns:
    HTML page showing success or error message.

reply_type.title: Reply Type
reply_type.description: Content type hint (e.g. 'thinking', 'tool_use'). None means regular text. Gateway decides how to render each type.

username.title: Username
username.description: Override bot display name for this message (requires chat:write.customize scope).

message_ts.title: Message Ts
message_ts.description: Slack message timestamp of the new reply

text.title: Text
text.description: Text to append to the last reply

reply_type.title: Reply Type
reply_type.description: Content type hint (e.g. 'thinking', 'tool_use'). Must match the type of the message being appended to. If it differs, the buffer is flushed and a new message is started.

username.title: Username
username.description: Override bot display name for this message (requires chat:write.customize scope).

buffered.title: Buffered
buffered.description: Whether text was buffered (vs immediately flushed)

BotApprovalStatus.title: BotApprovalStatus
BotApprovalStatus.description: Status of a bot creation request.

requested_by.title: Requested By
requested_by.description: Slack user ID (e.g., 'U123ABC') or Yupp user ID (UUID)

requested_by_user_id.title: Requested By User Id
requested_by_user_id.description: Resolved Yupp user ID of the requester

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of what the agent does

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Additional system prompt or persona for the agent

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the record was last updated

approver_slack_user_id.title: Approver Slack User Id
approver_slack_user_id.description: Slack user ID of the approver/denier

oauth_client_id.title: Oauth Client Id
oauth_client_id.description: OAuth client ID for the app

oauth_client_secret.title: Oauth Client Secret
oauth_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret (encrypted or redacted in logs)

oauth_install_url.title: Oauth Install Url
oauth_install_url.description: URL for admin to click to complete OAuth install

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: When the bot was fully created

approval_message_ts.title: Approval Message Ts
approval_message_ts.description: Slack message timestamp of the approval request

approval_message_channel.title: Approval Message Channel
approval_message_channel.description: Slack channel the approval message was posted to

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message if status is FAILED

BotCreationRecord.title: BotCreationRecord
BotCreationRecord.description: Full state of a bot creation request, stored in Redis.

slack_name.title: Slack Name
slack_name.description: Desired Slack bot username (e.g., 'giladovski'). Must be lowercase, alphanumeric + hyphens.

requested_by.title: Requested By
requested_by.description: Slack user ID (e.g., 'U123ABC') or Yupp user ID (UUID). Optional if requested_by_email is provided.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of what the agent does

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Additional system prompt or persona for the agent

BotCreationRequest.title: BotCreationRequest
BotCreationRequest.description: Incoming request to create a Slack bot for an agent.

has_slack_bot.title: Has Slack Bot
has_slack_bot.description: Whether the agent already has a live Slack bot

slack_app_id.title: Slack App Id
slack_app_id.description: Slack app ID if bot exists

slack_name.title: Slack Name
slack_name.description: Slack bot username if bot exists

RequestFeedbackRequest.title: RequestFeedbackRequest
RequestFeedbackRequest.description: Request body for POST /sessions/request-feedback (called by AHS).

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Slack channel name or ID (e.g., 'alert-backend', '#general', or 'C123ABC')

thread_ts.title: Thread Ts
thread_ts.description: Optional thread timestamp to reply in a thread

ahs_session_id.title: Ahs Session Id
ahs_session_id.description: Optional AHS session UUID. When provided for a top-level message, SAG registers the new thread so that human replies route to this existing session.

username.title: Username
username.description: Override bot display name for this message (requires chat:write.customize scope).

SendMessageRequest.title: SendMessageRequest
SendMessageRequest.description:
Request body for POST /messages/send.

Allows an agent to proactively send a message to a Slack channel.
Does not require an existing session.

message_ts.title: Message Ts
message_ts.description: Slack message timestamp of the sent message

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Channel the message was sent to

text.title: Text
text.description: New content to replace the last reply

message_ts.title: Message Ts
message_ts.description: Slack message timestamp of the updated reply
